verdicts.526_postcommit_fault_reached: YES, supported by status and source path. The preDynamics Armijo trace has 32 records, all with solver_status_code 0; five select trial corrections and 27 are certified no-ops (the no-ops are not corrections). The resulting transaction snapshot then reports INVALID_DISPATCH (code1), failing index0, diagnostics [-3,-3,-3,-3]. The fixture changes punch motion from kinematic to dynamic only in postEndpoint; the source postCommit call passes that endpoint to prescribed-motion validation, which rejects non-kinematic prescribed motion.
verdicts.527_postcommit_fault_reached: NO. At Newton18 the pretrial status is healthy, but the line search produces solver status NONLINEAR_SOLVER_FAILURE (code10), failing index18, with no tested trial accepted. Newton19 onward is blocked by that pretrial error. The postCommit prescribed-motion validator skips unhealthy environments, so the injected motion-type fault is masked by the earlier preDynamics Newton failure.
verdicts.alias_scratch: All baseline/aliased outputs compare byte-for-byte within each run. The 526 raw snapshots include the appended regional linearization/basis/AP/RAP/factor/pivot/node-block vectors; JSON binds their array counts and mode count 14.
verdicts.conditioning_vs_operator: Source198 selects FEMPreconditionerMode::regionalGalerkinContact (selector 4) and adds region labels only for that option. The source declares this a conditioning/preconditioner mode; material, fixture, timestep, physical acceptance threshold, and operator-source are shared. Native iterations and accepted-state hashes differ, as expected for a changed preconditioner. This audit has no matched same-state operator-action capture, so exact assembled-operator equality was not directly measured.
verdicts.rollback: Both runs reject control3 without advancing the cursor or mutating accepted-state-vector hashes. 526 rollback follows the injected postCommit INVALID_DISPATCH. In 527, Newton18 fails during line search and later records are blocked; postCommit validation skips the unhealthy environment, and that earlier preDynamics failure is the rollback cause. Certificate validity is cleared.
